ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_regret_normalized_tanh_mean
ir.intuition: Shift to a pairwise regret-based loss normalizing log-probability difference by total regret magnitude, using a tanh link to softly saturate the penalty, and mean aggregation for smooth gradient signals.
ir.pseudocode:
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
regret = delta_regret.abs() + epsilon
normalized_diff = diff / regret
loss = tanh(-normalized_diff) * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    epsilon = 1e-8
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    regret_abs = ops.add(ops.abs(delta_regret), epsilon)
    normalized_diff = ops.div(diff, regret_abs)
    loss = ops.tanh(ops.neg(normalized_diff))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
